package fixture

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/frankban/quicktest"
)

// The package clause of github.com/frankban/quicktest is `package quicktest`, so
// an unaliased import binds `quicktest` and is a violation just like a renamed
// one. A rule that only looked at explicit aliases would pass this file.
func TestDefaultBinding(t *testing.T) {
	c := quicktest.New(t)
	c.Assert(1, quicktest.Equals, 1)
}
